changes.comment: Extract the built-in Claude Code runtime into the publishable @excitedjs/agent-runtime-claude-code package and depend on it by default (issue #209 slice 4). builtin/claude-code/ becomes a thin core-owned adapter that maps the host create context onto the neutral @excitedjs/dreamux-types contract and supplies the host path/log/state contracts and the package-bin PATH the package must not reconstruct; the Claude Code diagnostic, host paths, and re-export shims stay in core so existing import paths are stable. The builtin:claude-code alias, runtime semantics, config, paths, and state are unchanged; no operator action required on upgrade.
